title: MM6 Medusa
description: MM6 adult female serpent-bodied medusa. Green scaled humanoid arms and face, a crown of individually coiled living green snakes for hair, stern angular native face, ornate dark navy-blue spiral-cup breastplate and torso armor with ornate gold trim, gold neck ring and wrist cuffs. Lower body is one long thick green snake tail with brown ring-shaped markings and a pale segmented belly, sweeping to one side on the ground. Preserve native proportions, nonhuman face, every hair snake, armored torso and coil silhouette; no legs, weapons, added jewelry or modern redesign.
regions: Dark navy blue armor changes to bronze or red. Green scales and snake hair, gold jewelry and brown tail markings stay protected. Pale gray belly plates retain the native variant-specific tone.
